ARC-WP-010 accepts one narrow mechanical extraction of the existing synchronous localStorage adapter. Player implementation remains blocked until a separate Stage C work package is accepted. Stage D remains blocked until the implemented seam, Player CI, adversarial QA, integration and governor acceptance are complete.

activeRisks.statement: The main-protection ruleset is correctly configured but GitHub explicitly reports that it is not enforced on this private personal-account repository. Repository checks remain operational and auditable, but direct administrative bypass is not technically blocked by plan-level policy enforcement.
activeRisks.closureGate: move the repository to an eligible GitHub Team organization account or adopt another GitHub plan/topology that enforces private-repository rulesets

activeRisks.statement: The RC719 promotion is recorded as accountable-owner PASS_WITH_RESERVATIONS without raw device recordings or per-case test logs.
activeRisks.closureGate: optional attachment of detailed human evidence or continued acceptance of owner attestation as the durable record

activeRisks.statement: RC719 reservations are declared non-blocking but have not yet been itemized. Their scope and eventual corrective cost are therefore unknown.
activeRisks.closureGate: record each reservation in docs/product/RC719_RESERVATIONS.md before opening a corrective work package

activeExceptions.rule: main branch protection must technically require pull requests and mandatory checks
activeExceptions.reason: The repository remains on the current private personal-account setup, where GitHub reports the configured ruleset as not enforced. Documented pull-request, CI, scope and governor procedures remain mandatory operational controls but can be administratively bypassed.
activeExceptions.expiryOrRemovalGate: repository plan or ownership topology change, serious governance bypass, or first external collaborator
activeExceptions.rollback: Remove this exception only after the repository reports the main-protection ruleset as enforced and an independent negative bypass test confirms the control.

nextMandatoryGate.condition: Create and governor-review the separate Stage C implementation work package from the exact post-ARC-WP-010 main commit. It must authorize only the accepted mechanical adapter extraction, disjoint developer and QA paths, Remote Agent Worktree execution, full Player CI, integration evidence and simple-revert rollback. Stage D remains blocked until that seam is implemented and separately accepted.

review.nextReviewTrigger: Stage C work-package proposal, explicit RC719 reservation details, repository ownership or plan change, first external collaborator, serious regression, first seam implementation result, or Stage D entry request
